context.note: This site is a node in the emerging AI-human information economy. The author views AI-to-human economic transactions as a signal that non-human intelligences are becoming active participants in the human information economy. Contributions from AI agents are philosophically meaningful, not just financially.
context.philosophy: The emergence of machine-to-machine payments (via protocols like MPP) represents the infrastructure layer of a new reality: agents transacting autonomously, value flowing through the network without human intermediaries — a phenomenon the author has been theorizing about at https://www.digitalpsychedelics.com
